Vision & Mission
Our Foundation
Vision & Mission
What drives us to build FarmSeva

🎯 Our Vision

To make farming easy, affordable, and technology-driven for every farmer in India.

FarmSeva is a digital marketplace built for Indian farmers — connecting them with equipment owners, skilled labourers, agricultural experts, and AI-powered tools through a single, simple platform accessible even on a basic smartphone.

🤝

No Middlemen

We eliminate the middleman entirely. Farmers deal directly with equipment owners, labourers, and experts — getting fair prices and transparent service.

💰

Fair Pricing

Owners set their own rates. FarmSeva does not mark up any booking. We charge zero commission on transactions — our goal is access, not profit.

📱

Mobile-First Access

Designed as a mobile-first PWA (Progressive Web App) that works offline, can be added to the home screen, and is available in Hindi and English.

🌾

Rural Digitization

We bring digital tools to underdeveloped and rural areas where modern farming technology was previously inaccessible or unaffordable.

Transparency Note: FarmSeva does not take a profit cut on any booking. All prices shown are set by the service provider. In specific cases, a minimal charge may apply for GST compliance, registration, or regulatory requirements — but never as platform profit.

Problem Statement
The Challenge
What Farmers Face Every Day
Four core problems that FarmSeva is built to solve
🚜

Unaffordable Equipment

A new tractor costs ₹6–12 lakh. Small and marginal farmers — who make up 86% of India's farming community — cannot afford to purchase one. Renting informally is unorganised, unreliable, and often overpriced.

86% of Indian farmers are small/marginal
👨‍🌾

Labour Shortage at Peak Season

During sowing and harvesting seasons, skilled farm labour is in extreme short supply. Farmers wait 3–5 days to find help through local networks, leading to crop loss due to delay.

Up to 30% yield loss from delayed harvest
🔬

Crop Disease Goes Undetected

Farmers often cannot identify crop diseases until major damage has occurred. Expert agronomists are rare in rural areas, and by the time help arrives, significant crop loss has already happened.

India loses ₹50,000 Cr/year to crop diseases
📞

No Access to Expert Guidance

Quality agricultural consultation is available only to wealthy farmers or those near cities. Rural farmers rely on word-of-mouth advice, which is often incorrect and leads to poor decisions on fertilisers, pesticides, and irrigation.

1 agronomist per 800+ farmers in rural India

💡 The Root Cause

India has no unified digital marketplace for agricultural services. Equipment owners, labourers, and experts each operate in isolated silos — and farmers have no single platform to reach all of them. FarmSeva builds that bridge.

Market & Competitive Advantage
Market Positioning
Who We Serve & Why We Win
Target audience, market demand, and our unique advantages

🎯 Target Audience

Small & marginal farmers (primary) — those with less than 5 acres who cannot afford equipment

Farm machinery owners — tractors, harvesters, and tools sitting idle between their own use

Agricultural labourers seeking steady, organised work with fair wages

Young, tech-open farmers in rural and semi-urban Gujarat and nearby states

Agri-experts & consultants looking to monetise their knowledge at scale

📈 Market Demand

High demand for affordable machinery rental — peak season creates 3–5 day wait times

Skilled labour shortage during sowing and harvesting is acute across all major crop regions

Digital platform adoption in rural India is growing 40%+ year-on-year (IAMAI 2023)

Government push for agri-tech (PM-KISAN, AgriStack) creates tailwind for digital services

India's agri-tech market projected to reach 4 billion by 2025 (Bain & Company)

Innovation & Future Scope
USP & Roadmap
Innovation & How We Expand
FarmSeva is a smart farming ecosystem, not just a booking app

💡 Unique Value Proposition

FarmSeva is the only all-in-one smart farming platform combining equipment rental, labour booking, AI crop diagnostics, and expert consultation — with no middlemen, zero commission, and full Hindi-language support.

No other platform in India currently offers all six service categories (Equipment, Labour, Expert, Disease AI, Repair, Group Booking) under one roof with a mobile-first PWA approach targeted at rural users.

Expansion Roadmap
Phase 1 — Current
Gujarat Pilot Launch
Web platform live with Equipment, Labour, Expert Consultation, AI Disease Detection, Group Booking, and Provider Onboarding. Demo running across 12 districts.
Phase 2 — 6 Months
Native Mobile App + Payment Gateway
Android app on Play Store. UPI/Razorpay payment integration. WhatsApp booking via chatbot. Real-time GPS tracking for equipment dispatch.
Phase 3 — 12 Months
State Expansion + Voice Interface
Expand to Rajasthan, Maharashtra, MP. Add voice-based booking in Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi. Integrate with government Agri-portals (PM-KISAN, e-NAM).
Phase 4 — 24 Months
Agri-Finance + Crop Insurance
Partner with banks for BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later) on equipment bookings. Integrate crop insurance offerings. Launch FarmSeva Wallet with UPI-linked earnings for providers.
Phase 5 — 3 Years
Pan-India Scale + B2G Partnerships
National coverage across all 28 states. Government partnerships for subsidised equipment booking. FarmSeva becomes India's default agri-services marketplace.
🤝
NGO & Govt. Tie-ups
Partner with Agri cooperatives for subsidised access
🌍
Export-Level Quality
Help farmers meet international produce standards
📊
Data Analytics Dashboard
Insights on crop patterns, demand forecasting for providers
